fn factorial(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n <= 1) then 1 else (n * factorial((n - 1)))))
  ensures (result > 0)
  effects pure
  example (factorial(0) == 1)
  example (factorial(2) == 2)
{
  if (n <= 1) then 1 else (n * factorial((n - 1)))
}

fn derangement(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n <= 1) then 0 else if (n == 2) then 1 else ((n - 1) * (derangement((n - 1)) + derangement((n - 2))))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (derangement(0) == 0)
  example (derangement(2) == 1)
{
  if (n <= 1) then 0 else if (n == 2) then 1 else ((n - 1) * (derangement((n - 1)) + derangement((n - 2))))
}

fn binomial(n: Int, k: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  requires (k >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (k > n) then 0 else if ((k == 0) or (k == n)) then 1 else (factorial(n) / (factorial(k) * factorial((n - k))))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (binomial(0, 0) == 1)
  example (binomial(0, 1) == 0)
{
  if (k > n) then 0 else if ((k == 0) or (k == n)) then 1 else (factorial(n) / (factorial(k) * factorial((n - k))))
}

fn sum_binomial_derangement(n: Int, k: Int, i: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  requires (k >= 0)
  requires (i >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (i >= (n - k)) then 0 else ((binomial(n, i) * derangement((n - i))) + sum_binomial_derangement(n, k, (i + 1)))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (sum_binomial_derangement(0, 0, 0) == 0)
  example (sum_binomial_derangement(2, 0, 0) == 1)
{
  if (i >= (n - k)) then 0 else ((binomial(n, i) * derangement((n - i))) + sum_binomial_derangement(n, k, (i + 1)))
}

fn solve(n: Int, k: Int) -> Int
  requires (4 <= n)
  requires (n <= 1000)
  requires (1 <= k)
  requires (k <= 4)
  requires (k < n)
  ensures (result == (factorial(n) - sum_binomial_derangement(n, k, 0)))
  effects pure
  example (solve(0, 0) == 0)
